note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955 in Islandmagee South and Templecorran. The district had 16 divisions. Fifteen are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (T. F. W. Nelson, returning officer, Rural District Council Office, Larne, dated 3 June 1955; Larne Times, 9 June 1955, p. 5): two polls, seven sole candidates declared elected, and six divisions where the retiring members were deemed re-elected. Ballycorr had no candidate and no retiring member is entered as deemed re-elected, so under the 1949 regulations (reg. 15(1)) the seat was left vacant until the next election; it is not counted here as a division with a result. No party labels are printed; places of abode are not reproduced. Returned unopposed.
